name: Game Speed Control
author: S.A.M Framework
description: Run the game faster or slower with four preset keys, each with its own speed slider in the settings. A S.A.M version of the community mod of the same name: no patched executable, and the keys and sliders live in the game's own Settings menu. Singleplayer only, because in co-op every joiner's own body is moved by their own machine.
